name: govuk-frontend-example-php
description: PHP Laravel + Blade example for GDS-compliant frontends using GOV.UK Frontend. Native PHP component renderers with fixture parity; Node only for govuk-frontend pin, Sass, and shared baseline tests.

scripts.start: npm run build:styles && php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=${PORT:-8000}
scripts.test: npm run test:baseline && npm run build:styles && npm run test:php
scripts.verify:docs: npm run format:check && npm run lint:md
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run build:styles && npm test
